details.description: The summary of the completed sync run; null until the task completes.

seen.description: The number of users found in Keycloak during the sync run.

added.description: The number of users created in the local cache by the sync run.

updated.description: The number of existing users confirmed against Keycloak by the sync run.

disabled.description: The number of local user rows marked disabled by the sync run because Keycloak reports them as absent or not enabled.

createdBy.description: The keycloak user id of the PDC user that requested this sync.
